message.content:
features
	CFDP_Library
		or
			send
				optional
					Send_Acknowledged_Mode
				optional
					send_fs_operations
			receive
				optional
					Receive_Acknowledged_Mode
				optional
					receive_fs_operations
			pus
				optional
					pus_rename
				optional
					pus_copy
			Reboot
				optional
					Reboot_Entity
				optional
					reboot_pus
constraints
	pus_copy requires send
	pus_copy requires receive
	pus_rename requires send_fs_operations
	pus_rename requires receive_fs_operations
	reboot_pus requires pus
	Send_Acknowledged_Mode implies send
	Receive_Acknowledged_Mode implies receive
